notes.title: Showcase Recap, Community Reactions & Bug Fixing Week
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Last week, we had the chance to present our game at a game showcase event on Gran Canaria. It wasn’t a release — just a test build — but it was incredibly exciting to see people play it in person again![/p][p]We received tons of feedback, and it was more than we could’ve hoped for. Some of the things we heard:[/p][list][*][p]“It’s a very ambitious project.”
[/p][/*][*][p]“The graphics are beautiful.”
[/p][/*][*][p]“The level of detail is insane.”
[/p][/*][*][p]“This feels like the most serious cooking simulator out there.”[/p][/*][/list][p]One guy was so impressed that he kept bringing his friends over, telling everyone how impressed he is by the game. (His quote): [i]“simuladora de cooking nivel extrema!”[/i] 😊[/p][p]A real chef stopped by, loved the feel of the game, took our contact info, and said he’s looking forward to the full release.[/p][p]And this one surprised even us: kids as young as 7, with no knowledge of English, managed to complete the tutorial and make a pizza from scratch with just a little help![/p][p]Of course, it wasn’t without bugs — this [i]was[/i] a test build, after all. That’s why this past week we’ve been heads-down working hard on fixes. We continue to polish the game while moving toward the demo.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support — we’re beyond excited for what’s ahead😊[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533992/ed952f038f64be01d54d34f6c67b5e786c0ff5fc.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Behind the Scenes: Crafting the Ultimate Pizza-Making Experience
notes.content:
[b]Welcome back to our DevBlog! [/b]Today, we’re diving deep into the creation of our pizza-making mechanics, sharing the journey from initial concept to the deliciously interactive experience you enjoy in-game.

[b]Designing User-Friendly Topping Modes[/b]
When designing our game, we knew we needed to cater to both new players and seasoned gamers. That’s why we developed two topping modes. The first mode lets you simply pick an ingredient and place it on the pizza with ease. Perfect for those just starting out, it provides a straightforward way to get familiar with the game. The second mode for the more experienced players, this mode allows for quicker and more efficient pizza topping. By prepping ingredients in special containers, you can rapidly assemble your pizza, just like in a real pizzeria.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533992/8d0afaa3d3c4b4d99e46c2f350a8169283e5a892.png[/img]

We also included specialized modes for certain ingredients. For example, you can grate cheese directly onto your pizza by holding a grater and a cheese block, or spread sauce with a ladle for that perfect coverage.

[b]Bringing Realism to Your Screen[/b]
To make the game as authentic as possible, our game designer teamed up with the owner of an Italian specialty store, who generously shared some secrets of making authentic Italian pizza and guided us on where to find the right recipes. This collaboration resulted in a diverse array of ingredients, including five types of cheese and two types of flour, enhancing the game’s realism and depth.
Our ingredient selection system is designed to give you freedom while rewarding precision. Recipes include mandatory and optional ingredients, and the more accurately you follow the recipe, the higher your rewards.

[b]Mastering the Art of Slicing[/b]
One of the coolest features in our game is the slicing mechanic. Built on Unreal Engine’s Procedural Mesh Component, we customized it to meet our needs. Slicing preserves the shape of the ingredient and animates the cuts realistically. For slicing multiple attached models, we developed a method to detach, slice, and reattach the models accurately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533992/262d05a58621d41171c67a4f8a1eda66a7ee0a7e.gif[/img]

[b]Realistic Cooking Mechanics[/b]
We wanted the cooking process to feel as real as possible, so we created a detailed thermodynamics system. This system ensures that heat interactions are realistic, whether you’re boiling, frying, or baking. You’ll see effects like boiling water, fire, steam, and smoke, all powered by the Niagara System and materials. Characters in the game also react to temperature, so be careful not to handle hot objects!

[b]Interactive Cheese Grating[/b]
Grating cheese in our game is both simple and satisfying. The cheese block is linearly sliced, and the slices are generated and fall naturally. You can grate cheese directly onto the pizza or into a container, with an auto-grate mode for those who want to speed up the process. Plus, we have pre-grated cheese for players who prefer convenience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533992/dad1d29fbcaab86436d91b5b9a56d780eb03f172.gif[/img]

[b]Throwing and Pouring Mechanics[/b]
Throwing ingredients is a lot of fun, thanks to Unreal Engine 4’s physics. The throw force depends on how long you hold the button, giving you control over the strength and distance. Pouring solid ingredients uses UE4 physics as well, while liquids and powders have a custom system that simulates their behavior realistically. This system takes into account density, surface ripples, and interactions with other objects, making every action feel authentic.

These detailed mechanics and realistic interactions make our pizza-making game truly immersive. Whether you’re a casual player or a hardcore gamer, you’ll appreciate the depth and authenticity we’ve built into every aspect of the game. 

Stay tuned for more behind-the-scenes insights in our next dev blog!

notes.title: Crafting the Perfect Dough: Challenges and Breakthroughs
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

    We're peeling back the curtain a bit to give you a peek behind the scenes of our game development journey. We chose Unreal Engine to power our game, and it's been a wild ride over three years of development. Buckle up as we dive into one of the coolest and most complex parts of our game – the dough preparation mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533992/4a35e39b5ba929739be8277d0dd36376206e09e2.png[/img]

    [b]Tackling Tough Challenges[/b]
Getting the dough mechanics just right was no cakewalk. We had to blend animations and physics to nail the rolling, cutting, and shaping processes. Unreal Engine's physics can be a bit unpredictable, so we had to get creative with workarounds to keep things smooth.

    [b]Wrestling with Physics and Animation[/b]
Animations were a labor of love, especially getting the pizza base just right when it hits the table. Dealing with Unreal Engine's physics quirks was a rollercoaster ride – from dough chunks misbehaving after cutting to objects going haywire when attached together. We had to constantly tweak and update to avoid those flying pizza box disasters.

    [b]Getting Real with Physical Simulations[/b]
To nail realism, we crunched numbers on volumes, densities, and accelerations. We fine-tuned Unreal Engine's physics for better dough cutting and optimized it for tons of little objects that really put our systems to the test.

    [b]Tech Behind the Scenes[/b]
Rolling the dough? Skeletal animations all the way, crafted by our awesome 3D artists. Cutting the dough? We used timeline animations and procedural mesh slicing because the standard Unreal Engine just wasn't cutting it (pun intended).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533992/fa5271a8e30d63ba3916078c206d7e59ec54b8e5.gif[/img]

    [b]Interacting with Objects[/b]
The dough's dance with the rolling pin was animated with Geometry Cache animations – over 300 moves for that perfect roll. And cutting? It's not just for show – it's real mesh slicing that reacts to everything from fridge chill to oven heat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533992/bdb7012d22bc3a7c777c2406341586f98dbf051e.gif[/img]
    
    [b]Tossing Dough Like a Pro[/b]
Tossing dough? It's like flipping pancakes but way cooler. We've got different animations depending on how epic your pizza-making skills are feeling that day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533992/ed3906051cc26c1ffcf41507f93d803417f347a2.gif[/img]
    
    [b]Epic Bugs and Funny Glitches[/b]
We've seen some real doozies. Ever accidentally walked through walls while rolling dough? Yeah, that happened. Also, we found out pizzas couldn't bake if your FPS was too high – blame it on some wonky calculations in Unreal Engine and C++ 👀 
During testing, one of our testers had a good laugh when a pizza box decided it was a UFO and started zipping around the room. Sometimes bugs make for the best stories 😂
    
    [b]What's Next?[/b]
We're not stopping here. Dough prep is our baby, but we're also adding hints and tutorials to make sure everyone can jump in and start slinging dough like a pro.

    Thanks for tuning in! Got questions or thoughts? Drop 'em in the comments – we're all ears and pumped to chat. Let's make this game epic together!

notes.title: Welcome to Haddie's Pizzeria: Join Our Dev Blog Adventure!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Qryart4PynQ;full][/previewyoutube]Greetings, fellow gamers!

We're thrilled to kick off our dev blog, where we'll be sharing all the juicy details about our latest project in the making. As Moonmana, an independent studio best known for our 4X strategy game Pirates of Everseas (which is hitting its remarkable 10-year mark!), we're diving deep into our newest creation.

For the past 3 years, we've been pouring our hearts and souls into our new game Haddie's Pizzeria, and now, we're finally ready to lift the veil and let you in on the excitement. Expect regular updates on our progress, sneak peeks into what's to come, and maybe even a few surprises along the way.

But that's not all! Get ready for epic contests where you can showcase your skills, exclusive giveaways with coveted prizes, and a community vibe that's as warm and inviting as a fresh slice of pizza (because who doesn't love pizza?).

So, buckle up and join us on this thrilling journey. Together, let's make magic happen!
